reason: This changes plan-cache eligibility semantics in the planner: queries accessing generated columns become cacheable by default. That is a narrow diff, but it sits on a high-blast-radius correctness gate in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cacheable_checker.go`; mistakes here can lead to unsafe plan reuse, wrong plans, or wrong results across executions. Generated columns also increase semantic risk because they depend on expression evaluation and schema metadata, so this is worth a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
